title: Reliability, Diagnostics, and Fault-Tolerant Systems
purpose: Learn how failures occur, how evidence reveals them, and how systems detect, isolate, recover, and degrade safely.
progression_rule: Complete modules in order until the first six are complete; later modules may be selected when their prerequisites are met.

interaction_contract.notebook_format: MATLAB scripts with %% Live Editor cells
